text:
devon: Quick mid-quarter needlecheck — leaning on owners to confirm status for Q2 OKR milestones. TL;DR: routing perf tests shipped, model-pinning slipped (infra), rollout gating by Dedicated. Can owners update: shipped/slip/blocked + next step? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Routing perf: shipped last week, monitoring looks good (p95 120ms). I'll add to dashboard. :white_check_mark:

lee: Model-pinning: slipped — blocker is image-builder for quantized artifacts. Infra has a patch but needs validation. Owner: lee. Next step: validate snapshot on staging by Thu. @tanvi can you help with staging quota?

tanvi: Yep, can bump staging capacity to 8 GPUs for two hours Thu morning. Schedule me a time, I'll reserve. :calendar:

kyle: Eval suite for regression checks is green except for one prompt category (contextual math). I'm running a targeted eval now. If it fails we'll revert canary. @maria FYI on routing tests.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: model-pinning-quant build failed on 1967894382 — error: 'cuda runtime mismatch'. See <https://ci.internal/1967894382|build log>

lee: Thanks @deploy-bot. That matches infra kernel mismatch. Devon — do we want to ship routing perf to a wider canary while model-pinning is blocked? Might help UX.

devon: Yes, push routing perf canary to beta customers only (50% traffic) and enable fallback to smaller model if mismatch occurs. Create canary ticket and tag #customer-beta.

maria: On it — creating canary ticket now. Ticket: RDW-4218. I'll put rollout windows and rollback steps.

tanvi: Confirmed staging window: Thu 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll post calendar invite.

kyle: CR ping: @lee can you review my PR for targeted-eval-fix? https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1845 — small test updates. Need review before EOD.

lee: Reviewing now. Quick comments inline.

devon: Owners, can each paste one-line status + owner + ETA by EOD? We'll take this as the async checkpoint for the milestone board.

maria: Routing perf — owner: maria — status: shipped to perf canary — ETA to full: 1 week pending metrics.

lee: Model-pinning — owner: lee — status: blocked by infra kernel mismatch — ETA: 3 days after infra patch.

tanvi: Staging expansion — owner: tanvi — status: scheduled Thu 09:00 PT — ETA: done Thu 11:00 PT.

kyle: Evals — owner: kyle — status: triage in progress on contextual math failure — ETA: 24h.

devon: Thanks. I'll update milestone board and ping sales about beta. If anything slips further, tag me. :raised_hands:

maria: Quick note — product asked to deprioritize a small non-blocking telemetry item; won't affect rollout.

devon: Good — keep me posted.
